verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product with user-facing data retention or deletion controls, so this self-serve control story is a category error for this kind of product. Its Data Protection practice advises clients on GDPR compliance; that is legal advice about other organisations' data handling, not a capability that lets a user control retention or deletion, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
